name: SOC CrowdStrike Falcon SaaS Integration Enhancement for Cortex XSIAM
description: Enhancements for CrowdStrike Falcon SaaS Security telemetry used by the SOC Framework on Cortex XSIAM. Reshapes `crowdstrike_falcon_event_raw` events where product = "saas-security" into properly-shaped XSIAM alerts stamped product "Falcon SaaS", so Foundation Product Classification resolves the DS:CrowdStrike/Falcon_Event ingest tag through product_map into the SaaS category.
author: Palo Alto Networks
